text:
amelia: Quick thought — should saved queries default to org-wide or route-specific? I'm seeing confusion in user tests where they expect a view they make in /routes to be only for that route. We currently default to org-wide.

jonathan: +1 on making route-scoped default for route pages. Org-wide feels too noisy. Could be a switch in the save dialog.

kevin: Concern: route-scoped leads to duplication of near-identical queries across routes. How do we avoid proliferation? Maybe add 'copy to route' vs 'link to org' option.

maria: We also need to consider RBAC. Some saved queries include token-level breakdowns — should visibility respect role-based permissions? cc @tara

tara: yes — visibility should mirror dashboard-level permissions. Also suggest autosuggest for existing org-level queries to avoid duplicates.

console-bot: deploy status: feature/save-query-dialog updated in staging ✅

amelia: UX: make the save dialog show three radio options: Personal, Route (this page), Org. Default on route when saved from route pages. Add a small 'share link' checkbox.

jonathan: For URL deep-linking, let's standardize params: `?s=scope&sq=QUERY_ID`. Example:
```text
?scope=route&sq=abc123
```

kevin: Telemetry ask — log: `saved_query.create` with fields: scope, creator_id, route_id(optional), model_id(optional), visibility. We need this to measure duplicate rates.

maria: Also add `saved_query.apply` when user loads a saved view. We want to know if route-default actually reduces ad-hoc recreations.

tara: Edge case: model-level saved views vs route-level. If route uses multiple models, model-level should be available as a filter but not default-scope. Maybe a hierarchical scope UI.

amelia: Implementation note: backend API add `scope` enum {personal, route, org, model}. Frontend: show breadcrumb `Route > Saved Views` and a small tag `scope: route`.

jonathan: ok — can we ship an experiment behind flag and test with 5 teams? Create tickets: FE-423, BE-321, TELE-77.

kevin: I'll own TELE-77. Will add events and dashboard in Looker for duplication ratio.

maria: I'll update the mock in Figma and prep user test script.

amelia: thanks all — priority P2 for initial rollout, but let's aim for internal beta next week.
